decision_rule.empty: POST iff predicted terminal value of POST minus WAIT > 0
decision_rule.resting: KEEP iff predicted terminal value of KEEP minus CANCEL >= 0
decision_rule.invalid_prediction: WAIT for empty; CANCEL for resting

hard_constraints: known outstanding exposure including pending orders and unreceived fills
post-only valid price and known book
population: neutral post/keep reference; one probe per empty or resting generation; causal hash-based selection; all exclusions retained as statuses
target: difference in complete joint-portfolio cash plus inventory at the common terminal (60.2s for first-minute windows); all uncancellable and pending fills represented by engine
continuation: one intervention then neutral post/keep on both branches; repeated learned decisions tested in the full policy replay
models: two LightGBM regressors; same pinned PULL-DEPTH parameters; 51 causal features including known remaining quantity and portfolio exposure

controls: same keep model with legacy timer entry
same keep model with always-post entry
evaluation.dates: five chronological folds on already consumed dates
evaluation.comparisons: beat TIMER and ALWAYS pooled and >=4/5 days at each clock, with all fills and excluding under-100ms fills
evaluation.risk: no higher integrated squared inventory at M50 versus either comparator
diagnostics: known state and input absence statuses
evaluation.local_null: 500 count-matched draws within day, side, hour and action kind; local selection only
evaluation.intervals: 1000 UTC-day bootstrap draws, only complete five-day replay populations
